text: 'Abu Dhabi Sports Council and RCS Sports & Events have renewed their partnership' for the organisation of both the UAE Tour and UAE Tour Women; no contract length or dates were disclosed. RCS MediaGroup is controlled by Urbano Cairo via Cairo Communication (59.693%).
short: ADSC and RCS Sport renewed the UAE Tour partnership (May 2025)

source.name: ProCyclingUK - UAE Tour & UAE Tour Women to continue as RCS and Abu Dhabi Sports Council extend partnership
